deep_dive.title: Learning Waypoints and Passage Events for Decentralized Multi-Quadrotor Trajectory Planning
deep_dive.abstract: Multi-quadrotor passage planning requires coordinated spatial routes and passage times under vehicle dynamics and actuation constraints. Optimizing these decisions jointly couples temporal allocation, nonlinear motion, and inter-vehicle interactions, creating a computational challenge for local trajectory generation. We propose a learning-optimization framework that predicts spatial waypoints and ordered passage events for independently solved quadrotor planners. A common physical time grid aligns the vehicles, with intermediate events fixed by the networks and terminal progress optimized locally to permit different completion metrics. Differentiable sequential convex programming incorporates rigid-body dynamics and rotor-thrust bounds, allowing collision and completion gradients to train both networks through the generated trajectories. In a two-quadrotor evaluation across 24 layouts, the adapted policy passes physical feasibility and sampled separation checks in all five held-out layouts. Their mean completion metric decreases by 1.52% relative to the inherited policy. The median forward time is 21.01 ms on the held-out exchange layout with matching numerical trajectory references. These results demonstrate that learned spatial and event parameters can coordinate independent rigid-body planners while preserving local vehicle constraints in the evaluated scenarios.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: A learning-optimization framework predicts waypoints and ordered passage events, then solves each quadrotor locally on a shared time grid to produce coordinated multi-vehicle passages.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 多四旋翼穿越规划需在动力学与执行约束下同时协调空间路线与通过时序，联合优化耦合了时间分配、非线性运动与机间交互，计算困难。本文提出学习与优化结合的框架，由网络预测空间路标与有序通过事件，并在统一物理时间网格下由各机独立求解局部轨迹，终局进度本地优化。实验表明该方法能在保持动力学可行性的同时生成协同的多机穿越轨迹，为分散式多机器人协调提供可扩展方案。
